_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.20 (build 87512, linux64, headless), read out of the running game with gdb rather than through Lua: the output of the CHUNK-GRID basis_noise kernel, Noise::noise(float, float, unsigned int, unsigned int, float, float, float, NoiseScratch&, float*), for four basis_noise expressions routed to Nauvis's elevation, moisture, aux and temperature during a --create. Per case: the expression, its seed1, the input and output scale exactly as the game passed them (f32). Per chunk: its world origin (x, y) and 1,024 values, row-major, row r and column i being world tile (x + i, y + r); the noise coordinate is f32((i*step + x) * inputScale) with step 1, and each value is what the kernel added to a zeroed buffer, i.e. sum * outputScale. Cross-checked: 2.0.77 (build 84539, linux64, headless) returned bit-identical values. Captured by scripts/probes/basis-grid (#451). Graded by crates/fmw-noise/src/fixtures.rs.
